title: Shape Optimization and Bernoulli Free Boundary Problems for the Riemannian $p$-Laplacian
summary: We study an exterior Bernoulli-type free boundary problem associated with the Riemannian $p$-Laplacian on a compact Riemannian manifold. Following the shape-optimization strategy of Ly and Seck, we formulate the corresponding volume-constrained shape optimization problem, derive its first shape derivative, obtain the overdetermined Bernoulli condition through a Lagrange multiplier, and establish a conditional monotonicity result under a Riemannian contraction hypothesis. The final successive-approximation argument will require additional geometric and boundary-flux stability assumptions.
